fixture_corrections: The first native old-version comparison contained fading chat. Chat was hidden without F1, retaining the overlay layer.

The first new-version comparison included drifting clouds despite frozen world time. Reviewed original frames showed clouds moving; clouds were disabled in the disposable fixture, with original thresholds unchanged. Finder-on positive controls visibly draw lines.
The initial Java regression run stopped at accessibility onboarding. Only isolated QA options were corrected before rerunning.
